intro: I'm Iván Brihuega, Ivanchux online. I'm in my second year of Network Computer Systems Administration (ASIR) in Madrid, and I'm a self-taught web developer.
I move between systems, networks and the web: I like building infrastructure you can see, touch and play with. I'm ambitious and restless, and I almost always have several projects on the go.

como_trabajo.texto: I build with AI tools in almost every step. They let me try more ideas, move faster and spend my time deciding what to build and checking that it works.

como_trabajo.titulo: No frameworks when they aren't needed
como_trabajo.texto: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, often in a single file with no dependencies. What I make can be opened, read and understood.
Visible focus, full keyboard support and respect for anyone who asks for less motion. On Retroterm-AI I applied a WCAG 2.1 AA audit to 16 pages and scored 100/95/100/100 on PageSpeed.
Several of my apps work offline, with no accounts and no tracking, and when they sync they do it encrypted.

pila.nombre: Generative AI for images, video and music

formacion.texto: First systems projects and websites with a database. My end-of-year project, built during my work placement, was Impronta.

clasificado.texto: Besides what you see here, I have experiments and projects I can't show yet. They are big, they take time and some of them mix development with generative AI for images, video and music.
clasificado.cierre: When they're ready, they'll show up in the lab.

busco: I'm looking for a work placement, a first job and collaborations in web development and systems.
